markets.name: Mile 12 International Market
markets.known_for: rice, beans, garri, palm oil and wholesale food bags
markets.tip: Buy early (before 9am) for the best bags. Haggle on 50kg bags, not on single kilos.

markets.name: Idumota Market
markets.known_for: Lagos Island wholesale: provisions, dry goods and household staples
markets.tip: Go on weekdays. Weekends are crowded and prices bounce around more.

markets.name: Oyingbo Market
markets.known_for: fresh produce, fish, tomatoes and pepper that move fast
markets.tip: Fresh items are cheapest at the end of the day, but quality drops. Choose wisely.

markets.name: Onitsha Main Market
markets.known_for: general wholesale, electronics, provisions and building materials
markets.tip: Bring cash and a trusted porter ID. Ask for the cluster where the goods you want are sold.

markets.name: Kantin Kwari Market
markets.tip: Compare at least three shops. The first price you hear is usually the opening number.

markets.name: Sabon Gari Market (Kano)
markets.known_for: grains, beans, groundnut and dry goods
markets.tip: Grain prices rise sharply during the lean season (roughly June to September).

markets.name: Ariaria International Market
markets.known_for: shoes, bags, fabrics, and Aba-made goods sold wholesale
markets.tip: Ask about factory-direct pricing. Many traders sell both retail and wholesale.

markets.name: Wuse Market
markets.known_for: provisions, vegetables and fish in the city centre
markets.tip: Prices are slightly higher than in the outskirts. Compare with Garki or Kubwa markets.

markets.name: Bodija Market
markets.known_for: one of the biggest food markets in the South-West
markets.tip: Market days move prices. Go early for vegetables and late for discounts on yam.

markets.name: Mile 1 Market
markets.known_for: provisions, rice, beans and fish from the Rivers creeks
markets.tip: Fish prices can jump in the rainy season. Check fresh stock before you pay.

markets.name: Ogbete Main Market
markets.known_for: Enugu's largest market: fabrics, provisions and general goods
markets.tip: Use the Ogbete area for bulk. Smaller shops nearby are cheaper for single items.

markets.name: Sabon Gari Market (Kaduna)
markets.tip: Buy grains directly from the lorry depot when possible; it saves a lot.

markets.name: Oba Market
markets.known_for: food staples, palm oil, yam and fresh pepper
markets.tip: Yam is cheaper right after harvest. Check the tubers for soft spots and bruises.
